title: Behavior Map v1
description: The single declared map from a root `AGENTS.md` map section to the member(s) that operationalize it: EVERY core skill under dadaia_workspace/public/skills/*/SKILL.md and EVERY scoped AGENTS.md/*-AGENTS.md source under dadaia_workspace/public/{data,scaffold,templates}/ (never the projected instance path — see the two citation-path bugs cited in the enforcer). It holds one row per member — a member (a skill name, or one scoped_agents_md path) maps to EXACTLY ONE row/section; a section MAY be owned by more than one row. `anchor` carries a `<!-- behavior: ... -->` comment-anchor id inside the section body, or null.

skill_md_line_soft.description: Over it, doctor warns SKILL-MD-LENGTH and names the split into references/*.md and/or scripts/.

skill_md_line_ceiling.description: The hard SKILL.md line limit, held by the library's contract test.

standalone_skills.description: The skills this project also distributes standalone, outside a dadaia workspace. The ONE data source for that set: every consumer of the set (contract tests, marketplace manifests) reads it here, never a literal roster of its own.

declared_overlaps.description: Pre-cleared applyTo activation-glob overlap groups among non-universal skills.

section.description: The root `AGENTS.md` map section this row's member(s) operationalize, title-anchored: '§N <Section Title>' using the CURRENT numbering (never a bare '§N').

anchor.description: The <!-- behavior: <id> --> comment-anchor id inside the section body, or null when the section carries none.

skill.description: The single skill (under dadaia_workspace/public/skills/<name>/SKILL.md) this row owns, or null when the row is scoped_agents_md-only.

scoped_agents_md.description: Repo-relative POSIX SOURCE paths (never the projected instance path — the checkout-vs-instance bug this enforcer already guards against) under dadaia_workspace/public/{data,scaffold,templates}/ this row owns. May be empty when the row is skill-only.
